claims.reason: S1 says the U.S. filed a civil forfeiture complaint against $61 million in cryptocurrency.

claims.claim: The crypto forfeiture is over Chinese-linked Iran oil payments
claims.reason: S1 says the funds are alleged proceeds of Iranian oil sales to Chinese buyers, laundered through two Chinese companies (Blessed Trust, Hexa Whale).

claims.claim: There is a new Russia sanctions law
claims.reason: S2 calls it a bill that passed, with 'Trump to sign bill later Friday'. The text cuts off and never confirms it was signed, so calling it a law is stronger than the source.

claims.claim: The Russia sanctions measure threatens tariffs up to 100% on top buyers
claims.reason: S2's summary says the top five buyers of Russian oil and gas face tariffs of up to 100%.
